references.label: Millennium Falcon center ramp
references.description: The center jump ramp advances Falcon features and starts Lightspeed Multiball.

references.label: Droids / Light Lock target
references.description: The target in front of the AT-AT lights virtual Hoth locks.

references.label: Darth Vader scoop
references.description: The left eject starts Vader features and Dark Side Multiball.

references.label: Luke VUK
references.description: The Luke up-kicker collects Hoth locks and the Hoth Super Jackpot.

references.label: right ramp
references.description: For the fourth, use the right ramp to light the Falcon engines, then shoot the center ramp for advances until Never Tell Me The Odds starts.

references.label: Salacious Crumb drop-target
references.description: Then repeat the Salacious Crumb drop-target hits and shoot the Sarlacc Pit to start Sarlacc Escape as the fourth event.

references.label: Sarlacc Pit
references.description: The spinning pit is behind the Salacious Crumb drop target.
